title: Nejat Immigration Ltd Broadens UK Visa Assistance Title
text:
Nejat Immigration Ltd Expands Comprehensive UK Visa Services Portfolio: Exper As the UK's immigration landscape continues to evolve with ever-changing policies and rising demand, Nejat Immigration Ltd, a Birmingham-based immigration law firm led by Mr. Mohamad Amin Nejat, has positioned itself at the forefront of offering tailored immigration services to individuals, families, professionals, and businesses alike.
In a recent overview, Mr. Nejat — an OISC-registered immigration Lawyer and University of Birmingham graduate — elaborated on the wide array of UK visa services now provided by the firm, citing the firm’s deep commitment to accessibility, transparency, and case-by-case precision.
Child Student and Dependent Visas
The firm has seen a rise in demand for UK Child Student Visas, especially among families sending their children to British boarding and day schools. Mr. Nejat emphasized that children aged 4–17 can apply under this category, but must attend an independent fee-paying school and meet specific maintenance and accommodation standards.
In cases where a child is 11 years old or younger, Nejat Immigration assists parents in securing a Dependent Parent Visa, allowing a single parent to accompany the child as a caregiver.
Enabling Global Education: UK Student Visa
With the UK remaining a top destination for international higher education, Nejat Immigration also handles UK Student Visas, helping clients gain admission to universities and colleges across the country. “The Genuine Student Test, English proficiency, and financial documentation are crucial components of success,” Mr. Nejat noted, citing common pitfalls applicants face without professional guidance.
Uniting Loved Ones: UK Spouse and Partner Visas
Among the most complex and emotionally significant cases handled by the firm are UK Spouse (Partner) Visas. The stringent £29,000 minimum income requirement, evidence of a genuine relationship, and specific accommodation standards are recurring challenges, particularly for applicants living abroad. Nejat Immigration offers detailed document checks, mock interviews, and expert handling of refusal appeals.
Empowering Entrepreneurs: UK Innovator Founder Visa
For those with business aspirations, Nejat Immigration supports applicants pursuing the UK Innovator Founder Visa, also known as the Start-up Visa. This category demands not only a viable business idea but also endorsement by an approved body. “The Home Office expects innovation, scalability, and market viability — our firm works closely with clients to ensure all three pillars are met,” said Mr. Nejat.
Building Careers: UK Skilled Worker (Tier 2) Visa
Professionals from overseas can apply for a UK Skilled Worker Visa, provided they have a job offer from a licensed sponsor. Nejat Immigration aids in verifying job codes, salary requirements, and certificate of sponsorship eligibility — components often mishandled by first-time applicants or DIY submissions.
Supporting Employers: UKVI Sponsorship Licence Applications
To support the demand for global talent, Nejat Immigration offers Sponsorship Licence Application Services for UK employers. “Securing a sponsor licence is more than filling out a form — it involves proving your business's legitimacy, HR compliance, and capacity to fulfill sponsorship duties,” Mr. Nejat explained.
Celebrating Excellence: UK Global Talent Visa
Another flagship service is the UK Global Talent Visa, tailored for individuals in fields such as Digital Technology, Medicine, Engineering, Art, Humanities, and Academia. Applicants must secure an endorsement from a recognized body, a step Nejat Immigration expertly facilitates by assessing portfolios, career history, and aligning documentation with endorsement criteria.
Unique Pathways: UK Ancestry Visa
For Commonwealth citizens with a UK-born grandparent, the UK Ancestry Visa provides a unique 5-year work and residency opportunity. Nejat Immigration assists with tracing eligibility through ancestral documentation, a process that often requires expert genealogical and legal interpretation.
Visiting the UK: Standard Visitor Visa
Finally, Nejat Immigration continues to support short-term travellers with UK Visitor Visas, including tourists, business visitors, and those coming for private medical treatment. “A well- prepared visitor visa application includes not just financials, but evidence of strong ties to the home country,” Mr. Nejat pointed out, underscoring the high refusal rates when such details are overlooked.

As UK immigration regulations grow increasingly detailed, Mr. Nejat stresses the value of legal advice that is both compliant and empathetic. “Our mission at Nejat Immigration Ltd is not just to file applications — it’s to safeguard our clients’ futures by getting it right the first time,” he concluded.
